sentences.en: Instructional videos are a key component of many online courses.
sentences.zh: 教学视频是许多在线课程的关键组成部分。

sentences.en: The teacher left some instructional materials on the desk for us.
sentences.zh: 老师在桌子上给我们留下了一些指导材料。

sentences.en: She found the book very helpful as an instructional guide.
sentences.zh: 她发现这本书作为指南非常有帮助。
